directory_profile_history_actor_chk.name: directory_profile_history_actor_chk
directory_profile_history_actor_chk.value: ("directory_profile_history"."actor" = 'PERSON' and "directory_profile_history"."audience" is not null) or ("directory_profile_history"."actor" = 'RETENTION' and "directory_profile_history"."audience" is null and "directory_profile_history"."actor_user_id" is null)

uq_employments_open_organization_id_user.name: uq_employments_open_organization_id_user_id
uq_employments_open_organization_id_user.where: "employments"."ended_at" is null and "employments"."user_id" is not null

uq_employments_open_accountless_email.name: uq_employments_open_accountless_email
uq_employments_open_accountless_email.where: "employments"."ended_at" is null and "employments"."user_id" is null and "employments"."email" is not null

group_events_title_chk.name: group_events_title_chk
group_events_title_chk.value:
"group_events"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL
        OR ("group_events"."title" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("group_events"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

group_events_times_chk.name: group_events_times_chk
group_events_times_chk.value:
("group_events"."start_time" IS NULL) = ("group_events"."end_time" IS NULL)
        AND ("group_events"."start_date" <> "group_events"."end_date" OR "group_events"."start_time" IS NULL OR "group_events"."end_time" > "group_events"."start_time")

group_events_repeat_chk.name: group_events_repeat_chk
group_events_repeat_chk.value:
("group_events"."repeat_freq" IS NULL AND "group_events"."repeat_interval" IS NULL AND "group_events"."repeat_weekdays" IS NULL
          AND "group_events"."repeat_monthly_mode" IS NULL AND "group_events"."repeat_until" IS NULL)
        OR ("group_events"."repeat_freq" IS NOT NULL AND "group_events"."repeat_interval" IS NOT NULL
          AND "group_events"."repeat_interval" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "group_events"."end_date" = "group_events"."start_date")

user_birthdays_tombstone_chk.name: user_birthdays_tombstone_chk
user_birthdays_tombstone_chk.value:
("user_birthdays"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "user_birthdays"."month" IS NOT NULL AND "user_birthdays"."day" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("user_birthdays"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_birthdays"."month" IS NULL AND "user_birthdays"."day" IS NULL AND "user_birthdays"."year" IS NULL)
